categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Touches unit test helper utilities in src/test/util/mining.cpp and mining.h, and carries the Tests label.
categories.rationale: Consolidates and hardens block template reconstruction across test utilities to prevent subtle test block invalidity. The description notes that utilities repointing block templates copied active-tip target and subsidy and could generate invalid coinbase scripts at low heights, which existing tests worked around but could trip up future tests.
